title: Left unitor of section-normalized ordinary adic reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, schemes X,Y, an isomorphism g:X → Y, native realizations R,S, invertibility of l on both schemes, tensor structures A,B, a coefficient-ring reindexing r, and V:ReindexTensor l X g A B r [def-sf-native-adic-tensor-reindexing]. For every M in the ordinary derived module category of Y, the derived tensor comparison V.tensor followed by tensoring pullUnit with the identity and by the target left unitor equals derivedPull applied to the source left unitor. This concerns the given normalized ordinary tensor and unit comparisons only; no common-stage realization comparison or tensor square is assumed.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, with Stacks Tags 03EK and 0FPT; agent-written pure-section and localization verification of the normalized ordinary left unitor.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat complex P with Q(P) isomorphic to M, using flat_representative. Naturality of the derived tensor comparison and the left unitors transports the desired equation along this isomorphism.

The coefficient unit complex O is K-flat by the proved unit_kflat helper. Extract the multiplication-normalized chain left-unitors from the two recorded ambient coherences at P and its reindexed complex. Apply the proved cochain unit square to those models.

Apply the recorded K-flat representative equation to (O,P). Naturality of the target tensor models along unitCochain, and tensorIso_both, compare the target unit model to the reindexed source unit model. Localize the chain square and use naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Apply the proved categorical left_unit_of_models cancellation lemma. The resulting unit is precisely pullUnit, the composite of the mapped source unit model, exact-derived factorization, localized unitCochain, and inverse target unit model.

mathlib_searches.query: An exact sectionwise inverse image of sheaves of modules preserves the left unitor of derived tensor, using its pure tensor comparison and coefficient unit map
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply and scheme-module pseudofunctor unit laws. None proves the normalized derived tensor unitor equation.
One hit, the generic left-unitor naturality law; used in categorical transport, without a specialized adic theorem.
Generic monoidal unitor and functor unitality laws; no normalized native adic result.

from.place: Ordinary reindexing unitor calculation in the proof of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-unit-contraction (BS Remark 6.8.15). The imported blueprint reference tool reports no blueprint ancestor for the assigned module.

lean.statement:
theorem reindexing_left_unitor (M : DerivedCategory (modules l Y S)) :
    V.tensor.hom.app (B.closed.monoidal.tensorUnit, M) ≫
      A.closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (pullUnit l X g V).hom (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (A.closed.monoidal.leftUnitor ((derivedPull l X g r).obj M)).hom =
    (derivedPull l X g r).map (B.closed.monoidal.leftUnitor M).hom
